title: MyCloudStudent
summary: Manage your stay with our dedicated Cloud Student Homes App
description:
Our MyStudentCloud app gives you control over your student tenancy, all from one handy app.

Save hassle in managing your paper work by keeping it all safe on your phone, easily accessible when needed. Within the App you can easily access everything from your contract, including the rent payments schedule, the EPC certificates, as well as lots of useful updates from Cloud Student Homes on your building and the local area.

The app contains all the details on the payment status of all your rent instalments, with useful reminders sent to you before each instalment​ is due. If you need to discuss payment terms or any other issues with your property manager, just open up the app and live-chat with your property manager. You can even report maintenance issues with photos and check on the status of those tickets.

Want to connect with your community? Using the news feed and built-in forums, you can meet new friends and find out about events in your community, so you don’t miss out on anything.

Features:

- Real-time maintenance ticket notifications
- Direct messaging with Cloud Student Homes Accommodation Manager
- Tenancy document hub
- Meet other students in your Cloud Student community
- Discover and post popular events in your Cloud Student community
- View all your upcoming and past payments in one place

MyStudentCloud is available for tenants who have rented their student accommodation through Cloud Student Homes.
